_comment: Tier-2 for skfem hyperelasticity#10, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Claim: an aggressive default load (E=1.0 / traction=0.1) drives det(F) <= 0 after the first iteration, log(J) goes NaN, displacements go NaN and the exit code is STILL 0 so an rc-only gate misses it; defence is a stiffer material (E=1000) plus explicit nan sentinels. Ran: MeshTri().refined(3), ElementVector(ElementTriP1), plane strain nu=0.3, left edge clamped, dead traction on the right facets, three configurations, plus a real child process launched with subprocess to test the exit code. Printed: THE QUOTED PARAMETER PAIR DOES NOT REPRODUCE -- E=1.0 with axial traction 0.1 converges with min det(F) = 1.0496, no NaN and an empty warning list. The mechanism does reproduce at E=1.0 with a TRANSVERSE traction of 0.5: first-iteration min det(F) = -0.4269, displacements NaN. It is not fully silent -- scipy emits MatrixRankWarning('Matrix is exactly singular') -- but nothing raises and the child process printing 'Max displacement: nan' exits with returncode 0, so an rc-only gate does pass on a NaN answer. The prescribed defence works: E=1000 keeps min det(F) at 0.9980 with a finite 3.2e-03 peak displacement.
